study type: Secondary analysis of a clinical trial
cohort: The study included 141 women with type 1 diabetes (T1D) using continuous glucose monitoring (CGM).
finding: Despite similar glycemic control, non-automated insulin pump users did not achieve improved pregnancy outcomes compared to MDI users, with insulin pump use associated with higher rates of preterm delivery and caesarean section.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was more common with insulin pumps (59% vs. 40%, P = 0.04) compared to MDI users, independently of diabetes duration, age and microvascular complications.
